observations: White chest freezer with a top-opening lid.
Interior walls are made of silver-colored metal.
The lid features a circular vent and multiple circular indentations.
The exterior front has a control panel with a dial and a power indicator light.
The bottom edge of the unit shows significant rust and paint loss.
A manufacturer's specification sticker is visible on the back of the unit.
The compressor and cooling coils are visible at the rear.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not clearly legible on the sticker in photo 2.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or may have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running with frost forming inside.

risks.risk: The compressor may be noisy or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with sound.

risks.risk: The cooling coils may be clogged with dust or debris.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear coils with the grille removed.

risks.risk: The capacity (string capacity) may be significantly lower than the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification sticker on the back.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the unit.
Video of the freezer running with frost visible inside.
Photo of the rear cooling coils with the grille removed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
